about:
JDM Supply LLC operates from Mesa, Arizona, and was founded in 2002. The company began as a supplier of new and used electrical equipment, focusing on circuit breakers, motor controls, and related components.

The company distributes new and used electrical material including circuit breakers, panelboard switches, motor control equipment, starters, contactors, panels, and fuses. It operates both a physical location at 1815 West 1st Avenue and an online store, and is open six days a week. JDM Supply offers emergency service without opening fees and provides free delivery within the Phoenix metropolitan area.

Customers include electrical contractors, maintenance departments, and industrial facilities that require replacement or new electrical components for commercial and industrial systems. The company emphasizes building long-term relationships and solving customer problems with a professional, friendly approach.

JDM Supply differentiates itself by waiving emergency opening fees and delivery charges in the Phoenix metro area, maintaining six-day-a-week availability, and leveraging over two decades of experience in the electrical supply industry.
